vetSays.line: ⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
Adaeze strikes the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Wanjiru. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Alex strikes the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes.
Wanjiru strikes the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes.
The Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes falls.
📺 Wanjiru brought down Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes, Ugly-Eyes (packmate). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Wanjiru brought down Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes, Ugly-Eyes (packmate). Together.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Paola, Alex, Sherifa, Wei and Nikos met them at the door — 5 put down. Paola, Alex, Sherifa, Wei, Nikos are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sherifa, Wei, Nikos, Farid and Miguel met them at the door — 4 put down. Nikos didn't come back. Sherifa, Wei, Farid, Miguel are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Denise just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Alex just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Denise, Alex, Sherifa, Adaeze and Wei met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Denise, Alex, Adaeze, Wei are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. 📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
